notes.title: Wishlist Cabernet on Steam now!
notes.notes:
After several years of work, we are so happy to announce our first full-length supernatural narrative RPG, Cabernet! 🦇 🩸 

We can't wait to hear your thoughts. And of course, don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401410/Cabernet/

[b]Change is brewing, threatening the established ways of alluring supernatural aristocrats. Sustain your facade as one of the living and struggle with your morality as a young vampire. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?[/b]

Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.
